title: Events loads faster: the app now runs next to the database

source.ref: Owner report 2026-11-17: I just clicked on events and it took forever for the page to load

detail: Production functions ran in iad1 (Washington, D.C.) while the database is in us-west-2 (Oregon). Supabase's edge log put the origin time of a one-row lookup at 80 to 130 ms, so /events paid roughly a tenth of a second for each of about ten reads in series. Measured before on production: signed out 1.4 to 2.7 s to the end of the HTML (440 KB), signed in 4.0 s (first byte 1.85 s). Fix (ADR-1973): vercel.json pins functions to pdx1, beside the database, and the /events loader drops its own auth.getUser() for the request-cached identity, starts its settings reads before the viewer reads, and reads memberships with circle names in one query. After timings are recorded on the PR.

verify.note: Fails on main: no function region is set and the /events loader makes its own auth.getUser() plus four viewer reads in series. Passes once vercel.json pins pdx1 and the loader reuses the cached identity.
